results.name: C1.1: Exact N_s-independence for N_s = 1..20
results.details: mu(beta=4.0) = 6.898777. Max rel error: 1.29e-16. Zero finite-size corrections (exact, not approximate).

results.name: C1.2: N_s-independence across 5 beta values x 3 N_s values
results.details: Max error: 3.93e-16. Intensive gap has zero finite-size corrections at all couplings.

results.name: C1.3: m_gap = N_s * mu (extensivity verified)
results.details: Extensive gap m_gap(N_s) = N_s * mu verified for N_s = 1,2,5,10 at beta = 3.0.

results.name: C1.4: Higher rep gaps also N_s-independent (8, 6, 10)
results.details: Max error for higher rep gaps: 0.00e+00. All spectral gaps are N_s-independent.

results.name: C2.1: Decay rate = mu(beta)
C2.2: Pure single-exponential decay (no subleading terms)
results.details: Effective mass variation across t=1..19: 0.00e+00. Single exponential confirmed (no excited state contamination).

results.name: C2.3: |G(t)| <= exp(-mu*t) for t = 1..49
results.details: Correlator bounded by exponential decay at all times. G(50) = 4.273815e-206 vs bound = 4.273815e-206.

results.name: C2.4: Mass gap decreases monotonically with beta
results.details: mu values: ['19.195', '13.111', '9.458', '5.013', '2.521']. Monotonically decreasing toward beta_c.

results.name: C3.1: Critical coupling beta_c exists
C3.2: mu > 0 below beta_c, mu < 0 above
C3.3: dmu/dbeta != 0 at beta_c (first-order)
results.details: Slope at beta_c: dmu/dbeta = -0.3346. Non-zero slope indicates first-order transition.

results.name: C3.4: lambda_1 = lambda_3 at beta_c (eigenvalue crossing)
results.details: lambda_1(beta_c) = 6.837803e+14, lambda_3(beta_c) = 6.838755e+14, rel_diff = 0.0001. Level crossing drives the phase transition.

results.name: C4.1: Connected correlator ~ 0 at t = 20*xi
results.details: xi = 0.145, t = 3, decay = 1.027300e-09. Cluster property satisfied.

results.name: C4.2: Spatial gap = temporal gap (O_h isotropy)
results.details: mu_temporal = mu_spatial = 6.898777. FCC O_h symmetry ensures all [111]-type directions give same gap.

results.name: C4.3: Clustering rate positive in confined phase
results.details: Clustering rates: ['19.1946', '9.4576', '3.5961']. All positive, confirming exponential approach to factorization.

results.name: C5.1: mu from formula = mu from eigenvalue ratio
results.details: mu(formula) = 5.012860, mu(eigenvalue) = 5.012860, rel_err = 1.77e-16.

results.name: C5.2: All eigenvalues positive (cross-check Thm 7.4.1)
results.details: Tested 8 reps x 4 betas. Reflection positivity confirmed.

results.name: C5.3: Ground state dominates partition function at L=10
results.details: Z_ground/Z = 1.000000. Trivial rep accounts for 100.00% of Z.

results.name: C6.1: Strong coupling: mu -> infinity as beta -> 0
results.details: mu(beta=0.1) = 38.18. Maximum confinement at strong coupling.

results.name: C6.2: Free theory: a_1 ~ 1, a_3 ~ 0 at beta ~ 0
results.details: a_1(beta~0) = 1.000000, a_3(beta~0) = 5.556019e-05. Haar measure projects onto singlet.

results.name: C6.3: Adjoint/fundamental gap ratio ~ C_2(8)/C_2(3) at strong coupling
results.details: mu_8/mu_3 = 1.985 at beta=0.5. Expected ~ 9/4 = 2.25 from Casimir scaling.

results.name: C6.4: Analytical formula mu = -3*ln(3) - 8*ln(u_3) verified
results.details: mu(analytical) = 9.4576004435, mu(numerical) = 9.4576004435. Formula is exact (tautological from definition).

results.name: C7.1: Lee-Yang zeros approach real axis as L -> infinity
results.details: Im(beta) at nearest zero: ['2.1566', '1.0783', '0.5392', '0.2696', '0.1348']. Zeros pinch real axis, confirming phase transition.

results.name: C7.2: Zero density scales linearly with L (first-order indicator)
results.details: N_zeros/L ratio constant at 0.1159. Linear scaling is consistent with first-order transition.

results.name: C7.3: Eigenvalue dominance change at beta_c (level crossing)
results.details: mu(beta=8) = 1.6968 > 0, mu(beta=14) = -0.6868 < 0. Ground state identity changes from trivial to fundamental rep.

results.name: C7.4: Free energy slope discontinuity at beta_c (latent heat)
results.details: d(ln a_1)/dbeta = 0.650259, d(ln a_3)/dbeta = 0.695768. Slope discontinuity = 0.3641 per cell. Non-zero latent heat confirms first-order.

results.name: C8.1: Z(eigenvalues) = Z(direct) for N_s=1, L=4
results.details: Z_eigenvalue = 1.023988e+04, Z_direct = 1.023988e+04, rel_err = 0.00e+00. Transfer matrix correctly reproduces Z.

results.name: C8.2: Z > 0 for all beta (positivity)
results.details: Tested 6 beta values with L=4. All Z > 0. Reflection positivity ensures positive partition function.

results.name: C8.3: Free energy converges to -ln(lambda_1)/N_s as L -> infinity
results.details: f(L=32) = -4.23934725, f_inf = -4.23934725, rel_err = 0.00e+00. Ground state dominance at large L confirmed.

results.details: Top eigenvalues: (0,0) d=1=1.005944e+01, (1,0) d=3=7.855793e-04, (0,1) d=3=7.855793e-04. Eigenvalue hierarchy correct for confinement.

results.details: lambda_3/lambda_1 = 7.8093756753e-05. Ratio G(t+1)/G(t) matches at all t=1..9 to machine precision.
